derivation: from a compound of G5259 (ὑπό) and a derivative of G5179 (τύπος);
def: typification under (after), i.e. (concretely) a sketch (figuratively) for imitation

occurrences.text: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.
Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
